questions.q: Which gland in the human body is commonly referred to as the 'Master Gland'?
questions.qPa: ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੀ ਨੂੰ 'ਮਾਸਟਰ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੀ' ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: The Pituitary Gland is the master gland because it controls the functions of many other endocrine glands.

questions.q: Which part of the brain is primarily responsible for maintaining balance, posture, and coordination?
questions.qPa: ਦਿਮਾਗ ਦਾ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਮੁੱਖ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਸੰਤੁਲਨ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਲਮੇਲ ਬਣਾਈ ਰੱਖਣ ਲਈ ਜ਼ਿੰਮੇਵਾਰ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: The cerebellum (the 'little brain') coordinates voluntary movements and balance.

questions.q: The Central Nervous System (CNS) is composed of the brain and the:
questions.explanation: The CNS consists of the brain and the spinal cord.

questions.q: Which hormone is known as the 'fight or flight' hormone?
questions.explanation: Adrenaline (epinephrine) is released by the adrenal glands during high-stress or exciting situations.

questions.q: What is the basic functional unit of the nervous system?
questions.explanation: The neuron is the nerve cell that transmits electrical signals.

questions.q: Which gland regulates the body's basal metabolic rate?
questions.explanation: The thyroid gland produces thyroxine, which regulates metabolism.

questions.q: Involuntary functions like breathing and heart rate are controlled by the:
questions.explanation: The Medulla Oblongata (brain stem) controls autonomic, life-sustaining functions.

questions.q: Insulin, which regulates blood sugar, is produced by the:
questions.explanation: The pancreas secretes insulin to help cells absorb glucose from the blood.
